name: calagopus-aio-heavy
description: Calagopus is a modern, open-source game server management panel built in Rust. Deploy, monitor, and manage Minecraft, Rust, and other game servers with industry-leading performance. This all-in-one template runs the panel alongside the Wings daemon. Requires separate PostgreSQL (e.g. postgres:18-alpine) and Valkey/Redis (e.g. valkey:latest) containers on the same Docker network.
